description: This Java source file defines a service class TenantAwareJpaPlatformUserDetailsService that implements Spring Security's UserDetailsService interface. It retrieves user details from a repository, applies caching, and throws an exception if the user is not found. The class is designed to be tenant-aware and integrated into the security context.

classes.name: TenantAwareJpaPlatformUserDetailsService
classes.description: A Spring Service class that implements UserDetailsService for tenant-aware user retrieval with caching support.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads user details by username, applies tenant-specific caching, and handles user not found scenario.
